verdict: ROAS is holding, but purchase volume dropped sharply this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.28 for every $1 spent on $1,485.72 in total spend — a healthy overall number. However, purchases fell 27% in the most recent week, with only 2 sales recorded over the last three days versus 6 in the three days prior, at nearly identical daily spend. The top campaign is showing signs of audience fatigue, and your Google Business Profile went dark on September 16–17 (dropping to zero daily actions from 25–35 per day in August), which is reducing local discovery that normally supports paid performance. Ad creative is being refreshed and the Business Profile issue is being addressed this week to stop the compounding effect before it carries into October.

watch_item.issue: Purchase volume is declining sharply over the last three days while daily spend holds steady, pointing to audience fatigue on the top campaign and a loss of local visibility from the Business Profile going dark.
